status_detail: Missouri DED announced on July 14, 2023 that AAIM Datacenters, Inc. was establishing in Moberly with a $4 million investment and 10 new jobs; later MAEDC FAQ says Randolph County is evaluating potential data center projects, while local June 2026 coverage/social snippets indicate officials said no current Moberly project was proposed or under construction beyond rumors.
notes: Original official evidence supports an AAIM data-center establishment announcement in Moberly/Randolph County, but I did not find a county permit, local abatement record, capacity, exact address, or current operational confirmation in this pass. Treat status as announced/unknown-current rather than hyperscale.

Checked Ray County official site, county planning/zoning page, Missouri DED county contact page, and web/news searches for data center/server farm/colocation/hyperscale.
